name: Broad Inspiration
description: You know how to strengthen the hearts of your troops and stir them to greatness. You learn the Guidance cantrip, which counts as a Bard spell for you. The cantrip doesn’t count against your number of cantrips known. Additionally, when you confer a Bardic Inspiration die to a creature, you can also confer that Bardic Inspiration die to a second creature within range.
